svg.title: GPT-2's 256 byte symbols: the 188 bytes that are printable characters stand for themselves; the other 68 (in the accent) are written as the characters U+0100 to U+0143, in byte order
svg.text: a byte's value in hex: row is its first digit, column its second
n counts them in byte order:
in its own order, not the bytes':
Why: the files are text, and a space or a control byte written as itself would break a line or vanish.
